item.title: eto — Tuesday, September 29, 2026
item.description: The Tuesday, September 29, 2026 edition: 3 stories, each one event told through outlets that disagree.
item.content:encoded:
Trade talk

  • Lester Quinones, Heat Sign Exhibit 10 Contract — RealGM
  • Hornets Sign Wyatt Fricks — RealGM · The Charlotte Hornets signed Wyatt Fricks, the team announced on Monday. Fricks, who went undrafted, averaged 15.7 points and 5.7 rebounds for Marshall last season. The Hornets also waived Rob Dillingham earlier on Monday.
  • Bradley Beal To Miss Start Of Training Camp Due To Right Knee Inflammation — RealGM
  • Hornets Waive Rob Dillingham — RealGM
  • Bulls Notes: Graham, Wilson, Claxton, Buzelis — Hoops Rumors · Bryson Graham, Caleb Wilson, Matas Buzelis, Nic Claxton on roster; Graham says focus is on building habits, not immediate contention. Wilson, 20, has high expectations; Buzelis wants more offensive freedom; Claxton says he’s healthy and ready.
  • Pacers Notes: Staff Changes, Zubac, Johnson, Centers — Hoops Rumors
  • Wolves Notes: Edwards, Ball, Connelly, Ownership, Expansion — Hoops Rumors
  • Lakers Notes: Grimes, Looney, Bronny, Reaves, Staff — Hoops Rumors · Quentin Grimes signs four-year, $60MM deal; Kevon Looney returns 100% healthy; Bronny James speaks of father’s legacy; Luka Doncic and Austin Reaves co-lead offense; Bob Beyer retires; Greg St. Jean promoted.
  • Minor Roster Moves: Hawks, Heat, Hornets, Pistons — Hoops Rumors
  • Anthony Davis Says He'll Assess Wizards Future After This Season — RealGM · Anthony Davis will play 2026-27 with Wizards, assess team progress, and decide on 2027-28 option or free agency after season ends. He holds $62.8 million player option for 2027-28.

News

  • NBA media day 2026: LeBron, Jaylen in Philly, Jimmy Butler's earrings top highlights — ESPN NBA · The 2026-27 NBA season is approaching with media days ending Monday. Here are the top scenes from around the league.
  • NBA media day buzz: Latest news, updates and intel — ESPN NBA · Here are the deals, trades and buzz across the NBA, including intel from Monday's media days.
  • Tatum 'comfortable' leading new-look Celtics post-Brown trade — ESPN NBA · Jayson Tatum says he's thankful for his time with Jaylen Brown and the success they shared but feels comfortable leading the new-look Celtics this season.
  • Wizards' Davis to wait on extension talks until next season — ESPN NBA · Anthony Davis plans on finishing the season with the Washington Wizards before deciding on any potential contract extension, he said Monday.
  • Ahead of 8th season, Zion 'not where I want to be' — ESPN NBA · Zion Williamson smiled politely, but kept his answer brief when asked how he would summarize his first seven years as an NBA player, saying "I'm not where I need to be."
  • OKC taking same approach to season, not focused on Spurs — ESPN NBA · The Oklahoma City Thunder said they are taking the same approach to the season and are not focused on Spurs after being eliminated by San Antonio in last year's Western Conference Finals.
  • KAT itching for Knicks extension: 'I want to play here' — ESPN NBA · Karl-Anthony Towns said he wants to get a contract extension done with the Knicks as he has one year and a player option left on his current deal.
  • Clippers apologize to fans, vow to move past Kawhi investigation — ESPN NBA · The LA Clippers opened media day on Monday by apologizing to fans in the wake of an NBA salary cap circumvention investigation that levied stiff penalties on the organization.
  • Haliburton 'ready to go' as Pacers aim to bounce back from gap year — ESPN NBA · Pacers star guard Tyrese Haliburton says he won't have any restrictions as he returns from the torn Achilles that has kept him off the court for more than a year.
  • Jokic leaves no doubt on Nuggets future, says he will re-sign — ESPN NBA · Nikola Jokic left little doubt that he plans to be back in Denver at least next season after saying he plans to sign his extension when it's offered next summer.

Raptors

  • Former Raptor Brandon Ingram to miss start of 2026-27 NBA season with partial Achilles tear — Raptors Republic · Former Raptor Brandon Ingram has a longer road to health than previously known. The post Former Raptor Brandon Ingram to miss start of 2026-27 NBA season with partial Achilles tear first appeared on Raptors Republic.
  • Immanuel Quickley is bringing another dimension to his game — Raptors Republic · If the jumper won't always fall. Quickley has a backup plan. The post Immanuel Quickley is bringing another dimension to his game first appeared on Raptors Republic.
  • Scottie Barnes wants what he believes he deserved last season — Raptors Republic · Barnes has unfinished business on defence. The post Scottie Barnes wants what he believes he deserved last season first appeared on Raptors Republic.
  • “You guys are going to be in for a treat” Barnes says as Raptors raise expectations — Raptors Republic · Scottie Barnes came to Media Day with spoilers. The post “You guys are going to be in for a treat” Barnes says as Raptors raise expectations first appeared on Raptors Republic.
  • Kawhi Leonard just gave the Raptors a reason to be optimistic — Raptors Republic
  • Darko Rajakovic made himself part of the Raptors offseason homework — Raptors Republic · Darko took “lead by example” literally. The post Darko Rajakovic made himself part of the Raptors offseason homework first appeared on Raptors Republic.
  • Darko Rajakovic is “super excited” to have Kawhi Leonard back in Toronto — Raptors Republic · Darko Rajakovic says he was super excited when Kawhi Leonard returned to Toronto. Leonard chose to come back home, citing family ties and enjoying the city.
  • Raptors open the 2026-2027 season with media day: Open Thread — Raptors Republic · Come hang out! The post Raptors open the 2026-2027 season with media day: Open Thread first appeared on Raptors Republic.

item.title: eto — Monday, September 28, 2026
item.description: The Monday, September 28, 2026 edition: 3 stories, each one event told through outlets that disagree.
item.content:encoded:
Trade talk

  • Get Your Latest NBA News From RealGM's Basketball Wiretap — RealGM · Get all the latest news and happenings from around the NBA with RealGM's Basketball Wiretap.
  • Mavs Intend To Keep Dwight Powell On Roster — RealGM
  • Blake Wesley, Clippers Sign One-Year Deal — RealGM · The Los Angeles Clippers are signing Blake Wesley to a one-year deal, sources told Jake Fischer of The People's Insider. The 23-year-old guard averaged 4.8 points and 2.0 assists in 31 games for the Blazers last year.
  • Blazers Notes: Morant, Potter, Carlson, Arena — Hoops Rumors · Blazers trade for Ja Morant, add Micah Potter and Branden Carlson; Moda Center remodel costs $600MM, faces protests.
  • Jalen Duren Expected To Skip Pistons Media Day Amid Contract Stalemate — RealGM · Jalen Duren expected to skip Pistons media day as he weighs one-year $9.6 million qualifying offer or a five-year $287 million max contract. Duren has not accepted the offer, citing perceived disrespect and lack of negotiation.
  • Suns Notes: Bridges, Maluach, Ighodaro, Booker — Hoops Rumors · Bridges, Maluach, Ighodaro, Booker: Suns trade for Bridges, Maluach averages 19.5 points and 12.8 rebounds, Ighodaro excels at handoffs and cutters, Booker hits 5-of-20 in four-game series.
  • Jalen Duren Expected To Miss Pistons’ Media Day — Hoops Rumors · Jalen Duren expected to miss Pistons’ media day due to no agreement on five-year, $200MM deal; he may also miss training camp start.
  • Terrell Brown Jr, Jazz Sign Exhibit 10 Contract — RealGM
  • Pistons Waive Gary Harris — RealGM
  • Terrell Brown Jr. Signs With Jazz — Hoops Rumors · Terrell Brown Jr. signs with Jazz on Exhibit 10; will likely be waived before season and join Salt Lake City Stars. Brown averaged 11.9 points, 6.4 assists, 4.1 rebounds last season with Greensboro Swarm.

News

  • Brunson gets assist from Knicks teammates, shares laughs on 'SNL' premiere — ESPN NBA · Jalen Brunson had four of his Knicks teammates -- Karl-Anthony Towns, Mikal Bridges, OG Anunoby and Josh Hart -- in the audience for his monologue Saturday night, in his role as host of "SNL."
  • Sources: Bulls trading Dillingham to Hornets for Hield — ESPN NBA · The Bulls have traded Rob Dillingham to the Hornets for Buddy Hield and cash.
  • Sources: Warriors, Curry reach 2-year extension worth $116 million — ESPN NBA · Warriors star Stephen Curry agreed to a two-year, $116 million contract extension, sources told ESPN's Shams Charania on Friday, ultimately opting for a pay cut and security over a max contract.
  • Hornets star Knueppel sidelined with hamstring injury — ESPN NBA · The Charlotte Hornets will be without Kon Knueppel for at least the entire preseason due to a left hamstring injury, the team announced Friday.
  • Altman on LeBron's 76ers move: Cavs have 'too much of a good thing' to worry — ESPN NBA · Cavs president of basketball operations Koby Altman said he wasn't fazed when LeBron James chose to sign with the Sixers, saying, "We're built for a sustainable run here regardless of one outcome."
  • LeBron: Maxey friendship, desire to help Embiid drove 76ers decision — ESPN NBA · LeBron James says his long-standing friendship with All-Star Tyrese Maxey and a desire to help Joel Embiid win his first NBA title played significant roles in his decision to sign with the 76ers.
  • Kyrie ready to 'kick some butt' after lengthy ACL recovery — ESPN NBA · Kyrie Irving said he is under no physical restrictions from the torn ACL in his left knee that sidelined him 19 months ago, an injury that he called "probably the best thing that happened to me."
  • 💰 Flagg's 1-of-1 rookie debut patch card sells for record $8.04M — ESPN NBA · The card was sold in early Friday morning at 2 a.m. ET.
  • Bulls-Hornets trade: Chicago adds shooting in Buddy Hield as Charlotte takes flier on Rob Dillingham — CBS Sports NBA · Hield has been traded twice this offseason while Dillingham, the No. 8 pick in 2024, is on to his third team
  • Grades for every NBA offseason signing: Why Warriors get a B for extending Steph Curry — ESPN NBA · We're grading the biggest free agent signings and extensions, including Steph's new two-year deal.

Raptors

  • What are the three most important questions the Raptors can answer this 2026-27 preseason? — Raptors Republic · The Raptors are about to play basketball. What should we watch for?
